svg.aria-label: Results: 74.4%: Resume classifier with embeddings, up from 71.8% with TF-IDF; ~98%: Fake-news classifier. The investigation says why that overstates it; 0.86: Churn ROC-AUC, with 83% recall on churners; 6: Repos pinned, each with its caveat written down
